blurb:
Go beyond the ordinary NASA visit and experience Space Center Houston at its fullest! Your admission ticket opens the door to an incredible day of space exploration, from the massive Saturn V and Rocket Park to Independence Plaza, Artemis, Starship Gallery, Mission Mars, the International Space Station and more. 

But the real highlight? Your Historic Mission Control Boarding Pass. Step aboard the NASA tram and travel to the legendary Mission Control Center—the very place where Apollo missions, including Apollo 11, were guided and history was made. It’s one thing to see NASA’s spacecraft and artifacts; it’s another to stand inside the rooms where some of humanity’s greatest moments unfolded. 

With plenty of time to explore at your own pace and complimentary tram experiences available, this is your chance to discover the heart, history and wonder of America’s space program. 

Come see the rockets. Touch a moon rock. Then stand where history happened.
